sources.note: Nothing; documents that only de Clercq 1893, 1894 [overview, minimal] and Laycock 1972 [wordlist] exist for Liki.

sources.citation: Sterner, Robert H. [& Joyce Sterner]. 1974. Liki Wordlist [Survey word list (standard), 'LIKIWINI (Sobei)', Pulau Liki, 16 Aug 1974, informant Akau Teno]. MS, 4 pp., 74 entries. SIL Language & Culture Archives 69262. (= Glottolog 'Sterner & Sterner 1974 Likiwini')
sources.note: No prose at all, but primary stress is marked (raised vertical stroke) on almost every one of the 74 handwritten phonetic forms; position varies: initial in 'dabu 'head', 'mani 'bird', 'fati 'stone', 'yafu 'fire', 'maros 'sits' but final in tam'tu 'man', mut'ni 'woman', el'we 'dog', sa'lil 'walks', dua'he 'big', nE'tu 'small', ma'do 'moon'; penult/other in longer forms (mE'tarfE 'smoke', tim'pana? 'eats', 'mimbiku 'elbow'). Data only, no rule stated.

sources.note: Liki/Moar is not among the six vocabularies treated (Sobei, Wakde, Masimasi, Anus, Bonggo, Tarpia); grep Liki/Moar = 0; no stress statement for any language.
